qualification.details: Assistant Nursing Superintendent: B.Sc. Nursing (4 year course) or B.Sc. (Post-certificate)/ B.Sc. Nursing (Post-Basic) (2 year course) from INC recognized Institute/ University with 6 years experience in minimum 200 bedded Hospital. Child Psychologist: M.A./ M.Sc. in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology and at least 2 years experience in Child & Adolescence mental health. Medical Officer (Homeopathy): Degree in Homeopathy from recognized University/ Statutory State Board/ Council with enrolment on Central/ State Register and 3 years clinical/ teaching experience. Medical Technology with Radiotherapy and 2 years experience in Radiotherapy Department. Tutor/ Clinical Instructor: B.Sc. Nursing Degree from recognized Institution/ University or Registered Nurse and Midwife with sister Tutors Diploma with 3 years experience in teaching Institution.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Nagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for AIIMS Nagpur Various Group-A Non-Faculty Posts is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for various Group-A Non-Faculty posts announced by AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for AIIMS Nagpur vacancies?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the posts is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs 1000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for SC/ST candidates is Rs 800/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Computer Based Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for these posts is as per Level-10 (7th CPC).

faq.question: Q9. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post and include degrees like B.Sc. Nursing, M.Sc. in relevant fields, and degrees in Homeopathy and Unani.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and online application link can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
